true_false.question_en: Variance is a measure of central tendency.

true_false.question_ar: هل يستخدم المتوسط التوافقي عادة للمعدلات والسرعات؟

short_answer.question_en: Define Big Data in your own words.
short_answer.question_ar: عرف البيانات الضخمة بأسلوبك الخاص.
short_answer.answer: Big Data refers to extremely large and complex datasets that cannot be efficiently processed using traditional data processing systems. It includes structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data and requires distributed computing systems for storage and analysis.

short_answer.question_en: Explain the difference between Volume and Velocity.
short_answer.question_ar: اشرح الفرق بين الحجم (Volume) والسرعة (Velocity).
short_answer.answer:
• Volume: Refers to the amount or size of data generated.
• Velocity: Refers to the speed at which data is generated and processed.

short_answer.question_en: Why do traditional systems struggle with Big Data?
short_answer.question_ar: لماذا تواجه الأنظمة التقليدية صعوبة في التعامل مع البيانات الضخمة؟
short_answer.answer:
Traditional systems struggle with Big Data because:

• Limited scalability → rely on single-server (vertical scaling).
• Cannot handle huge data volumes → performance drops with TB/PB data.
• Poor support for unstructured data → designed for structured tables only.
• Slow processing → lack distributed and parallel processing.
• High cost → scaling hardware becomes expensive.

short_answer.question_en: List the main components of the Big Data technology stack.
short_answer.question_ar: اشرح المكونات الرئيسية لبنية البيانات الضخمة.
short_answer.answer:
The main components of Big Data Architecture are:

Ingestion → Collects data from sources (batch or streaming).
Storage → Stores large data in distributed systems (e.g., HDFS).
Processing → Transforms and analyzes data (batch or real-time).
Analytics → Presents insights via dashboards, queries, or ML models.
Security & monitoring layer: ensures safety and system health.

short_answer.question_en: What is the difference between ETL and ELT?
short_answer.question_ar: ما الفرق بين ETL و ELT؟
short_answer.answer: ETL transforms data before loading it into storage, while ELT loads data first and then performs transformation inside the storage system.

short_answer.question_en: Define fault tolerance and give one replication strategy example.
short_answer.question_ar: عرّف تحمل الأخطاء واذكر مثالاً على إحدى استراتيجيات النسخ المتماثل.
short_answer.answer:
Fault tolerance is the ability of a system to continue operating even if some components fail.
Example: Data replication in HDFS, where each data block is stored in multiple nodes.

short_answer.question_en: What are the benefits of a Data Lake?
short_answer.question_ar: ما هي فوائد بحيرة البيانات (Data Lake)؟
short_answer.answer:
• Stores structured and unstructured data
• Highly scalable
• Low-cost storage
• Supports machine learning and advanced analytics
• Flexible schema-on-read approach

short_answer.question_en: Explain the importance of monitoring in distributed systems.
short_answer.question_ar: اشرح أهمية المراقبة في الأنظمة الموزعة.
short_answer.answer:
Monitoring ensures system reliability by:
• Detecting failures early
• Tracking performance metrics
• Preventing downtime
• Supporting autoscaling decisions
• Improving system optimization

short_answer.question_en: Mention two Big Data use cases in healthcare or e-commerce.
short_answer.question_ar: اذكر حالتي استخدام للبيانات الضخمة في الرعاية الصحية أو التجارة الإلكترونية.
short_answer.answer:
• Predicting disease outbreaks using patient data (Healthcare)
• Recommendation systems for online shopping (E-commerce)

short_answer.question_en: Define Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA).
short_answer.question_ar: عرّف تحليل البيانات الاستكشافي (EDA).
short_answer.answer: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) is the process of analyzing and visualizing data to understand its structure, discover patterns, detect anomalies, and gain insights before building machine learning models.

short_answer.question_en: Explain the difference between univariate and multivariate plots.
short_answer.question_ar: اشرح الفرق بين الرسوم أحادية المتغير ومتعددة المتغيرات.
short_answer.answer: Univariate plots analyze a single variable and its distribution, while multivariate plots analyze relationships and interactions among two or more variables.

short_answer.question_en: Define scalability in Big Data systems.
short_answer.question_ar: عرّف قابلية التوسع في أنظمة البيانات الضخمة.
short_answer.answer: Scalability is the ability of a system to handle increasing amounts of data, users, or workload by adding resources without significantly affecting performance.

short_answer.question_en: Explain the difference between batch and stream processing.
short_answer.question_ar: اشرح الفرق بين المعالجة الدفعية والمعالجة اللحظية.
short_answer.answer: Batch processing handles large amounts of collected data at scheduled intervals, while stream processing handles data continuously in real time as it arrives.

short_answer.question_en: What is the role of autoscaling?
short_answer.question_ar: ما دور التوسع التلقائي (Autoscaling)؟
short_answer.answer: Autoscaling automatically increases or decreases computing resources based on workload demand to maintain performance and optimize resource usage.

short_answer.question_en: Explain one benefit of geo-replication.
short_answer.question_ar: اشرح إحدى فوائد النسخ الجغرافي (Geo-Replication).
short_answer.answer: Geo-replication improves disaster recovery by maintaining copies of data in multiple geographic regions, allowing systems to continue operating if one region fails.

short_answer.question_en: What are the main components of distribution analysis?
short_answer.question_ar: ما هي المكونات الرئيسية لتحليل التوزيع؟
short_answer.answer: The main components of distribution analysis include central tendency (mean, median, mode), dispersion (range, variance, standard deviation), skewness, and outlier detection.

short_answer.question_en: Why is data visualization important in machine learning?
short_answer.question_ar: لماذا يعد التصور البياني للبيانات مهمًا في تعلم الآلة؟
short_answer.answer: Data visualization helps understand data patterns, identify outliers, detect relationships between variables, and support better feature selection and model development.

short_answer.question_en: List two best practices in data visualization.
short_answer.question_ar: اذكر ممارستين من أفضل ممارسات التصور البياني للبيانات.
short_answer.answer: Use clear labels and titles, and choose the appropriate chart type for the data being presented.

short_answer.question_en: Why is RDBMS not suitable for Big Data workloads?
short_answer.question_ar: لماذا لا يعد RDBMS مناسبًا لأحمال عمل البيانات الضخمة؟
short_answer.answer: RDBMS systems are not suitable because they rely on vertical scaling, have limited ability to handle massive distributed datasets, and are optimized for structured data and transactional workloads rather than large-scale analytics.

short_answer.question_en: What are the main advantages of Hadoop?
short_answer.question_ar: ما هي المزايا الرئيسية لـ Hadoop؟
short_answer.answer:
• Horizontal scalability
• Fault tolerance via replication
• Cost-effective distributed storage
• Ability to process large and diverse datasets
• Parallel processing capability

short_answer.question_en: Explain the difference between HDFS and HBase.
short_answer.question_ar: اشرح الفرق بين HDFS و HBase.
short_answer.answer:
• HDFS: Distributed file system for storing large files.
• HBase: NoSQL database built on top of HDFS for real-time read/write access.

short_answer.question_en: Compare MapReduce and Spark.
short_answer.question_ar: قارن بين MapReduce و Spark.
short_answer.answer:
• MapReduce: Disk-based batch processing, slower due to I/O overhead.
• Spark: In-memory processing, faster and supports iterative workloads and real-time analytics.

short_answer.question_en: What is the role of Apache Ambari in Hadoop?
short_answer.question_ar: ما هو دور Apache Ambari في Hadoop؟
short_answer.answer: Apache Ambari is used to install, configure, monitor, and manage Hadoop clusters through a centralized web interface.
